title: What does Strategic Lab Partners do?
content:
Strategic Lab Partners (SLP) designs, builds, and manages turnkey kitting and logistics programs for organizations that need precise, repeatable, and compliant product deployment. We sit at the intersection of product design, packaging engineering, and 3PL execution, so your kits don't just look right on paper—they arrive ready for use in the real world.

SLP supports healthcare, retail, clinical studies, and consumer goods brands with end‑to‑end solutions that include:

  • Program design: translating your business, clinical, or retail objectives into a scalable kitting and deployment model.
  • Kit engineering: component selection, packaging design, labeling, and instructions that work in the field.
  • Manufacturing & assembly: building kits at scale with quality controls and documentation.
  • 3PL deployment: warehousing, inventory management, and distribution to clinics, stores, study sites, or end consumers.
  • Digital oversight with SLP CONNECT™: visibility into orders, inventory, and program performance.

In short, SLP turns complex product and kit concepts into operational reality—so your teams, sites, and customers receive exactly what they need, when they need it, in a format they can trust.

title: Who does Strategic Lab Partners work with?
content:
Strategic Lab Partners works with organizations that need reliable, scalable, and compliant kitting and logistics support. Our clients typically operate in:

  • Healthcare and diagnostics: labs, diagnostic companies, and health systems that rely on accurate, ready‑to‑use kits.
  • Retail and consumer health: brands that deliver at‑home testing, wellness, or health‑adjacent products through retail or e‑commerce.
  • Clinical research: sponsors, CROs, and site networks that need consistent study kits and controlled distribution.
  • Consumer goods and specialty products: companies that require curated, multi‑component kits delivered to customers or partners.

We are a fit for teams that value precision, repeatability, and visibility—and who want a partner that can bridge the gap between product strategy, kit design, and 3PL execution.

If your organization is scaling a program, launching a new kit, or struggling with fragmented logistics, SLP is designed to operate as an extension of your internal team.

title: What makes SLP different from other suppliers?
content:
Most "kit suppliers" focus on components and packaging. Strategic Lab Partners goes further—we design, build, and operate the entire kitting and deployment ecosystem around your program.

Three things set SLP apart:

  1. End‑to‑end ownership: We connect program design, kit engineering, manufacturing, warehousing, and 3PL deployment into a single, accountable workflow.
  2. Domain depth: We understand the realities of healthcare, retail, clinical research, and consumer goods—so kits are designed for real‑world use, not just for a spec sheet.
  3. Digital visibility with SLP CONNECT™: Our digital layer gives you oversight into orders, inventory, and program performance instead of leaving you blind once kits leave the dock.

The result is a partner that doesn't just ship boxes—we help you build a reliable, scalable, and defensible program that reflects your brand and protects your reputation.

title: What industries does Strategic Lab Partners support?
content:
Strategic Lab Partners is built for organizations that rely on precise, multi‑component kits and controlled deployment. We primarily support:

  • Healthcare and diagnostics – test kits, collection kits, and clinical support kits.
  • Retail and consumer health – at‑home testing, wellness programs, and health‑adjacent products.
  • Clinical research – study kits, site support kits, and controlled distribution to investigators.
  • Consumer goods and specialty products – curated kits that combine multiple SKUs into a single, branded experience.

Across these industries, SLP provides a consistent backbone: program design, kit engineering, manufacturing, warehousing, and 3PL deployment—supported by digital oversight through SLP CONNECT™.

title: What is kitting and why does it matter?
content:
Kitting is the process of assembling multiple components—products, supplies, instructions, and packaging—into a single, ready‑to‑use unit. In healthcare, retail, clinical research, and consumer goods, kitting is what turns a collection of parts into a usable experience.

When kitting is done well, it reduces errors, speeds up workflows, and creates a consistent experience for clinicians, staff, and customers. When it's done poorly, it creates confusion, waste, and risk.

Strategic Lab Partners focuses on kitting as a discipline: we design kits so they are intuitive, compliant, and repeatable—and then we back that design with manufacturing, warehousing, and 3PL deployment so the same kit shows up correctly every time.

For organizations scaling programs or entering new markets, kitting is often the difference between a concept that looks good in a slide deck and a program that actually works in the field.
